name: Nine To Five

features.name: Wild variants
features.description: Wilds transform into types with different effects.

review:
Nine To Five is a 5x4 office satire slot. xNudge Wilds land on reels 2 to 5 and gain +1 per nudge, and xWays reveal two to four symbols, all the same if several land. Regular wilds on reels 2 to 5 transform into variants such as the Green Wild, which carries a random multiplier.

Nolimit rates it Insane volatility, with a 9,217x cap, an unusually low ceiling for that rating. Office humour with Nolimit City's usual edge.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
